zh.title: 芝加哥奧黑爾機場（ORD）航管人力不足，FAA一度暫停飛往當地的航班起飛
zh.summary: 因芝加哥近場航管人力不足，美國聯邦航空總署11月23日一度要求部分飛往奧黑爾國際機場的航班留在出發地，當天中午解除限制。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）11月23日發布地面停飛通告，要求部分飛往芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場（ORD）的航班暫留出發地。措施涵蓋美國及加拿大部分航管區，並非暫停所有從奧黑爾機場起飛的航班。
FAA在提供給NBC Chicago的聲明中，將原因歸於芝加哥終端雷達近場管制設施人力不足。FAA原訂措施實施至芝加哥當地時間中午12時15分，並於中午發布解除通告；NBC Chicago報導，限制解除後仍有部分離場航班延誤。

en.title: FAA briefly holds Chicago O’Hare-bound flights over air traffic control staffing
en.summary: The FAA temporarily held some flights bound for Chicago O’Hare International Airport at their departure airports on November 23, citing staffing constraints. It lifted the ground stop around noon local time.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a ground stop on November 23 for some flights bound for Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD). It covered departures from parts of the United States and Canada; it did not ground all flights departing O’Hare.

The FAA attributed the pause to staffing constraints at Chicago Terminal Radar Approach Control in a statement to NBC Chicago. The agency initially scheduled the restriction to run until 12:15 p.m. local time and issued a cancellation advisory around noon. NBC Chicago reported that some departure delays remained after the restriction was lifted.

zh.title: GE Aerospace國防部門執行長將於2027年離任 工程副總裁將立即代理
zh.summary: GE Aerospace國防部門執行長將於2027年首季離任，已公佈代理人選。
body: GE Aerospace於2026年11月23日表示，國防與系統部門總裁兼執行長Amy Gowder將於2027年第一季離任。
國防與系統部門工程副總裁Darin DiTommaso將立即出任代理總裁兼執行長。GE Aerospace正尋找永久接任人選。
Amy Gowder於2022年4月加入GE Aerospace，出任國防部門執行長。Darin DiTommaso曾領導多項引擎計畫的性能與初步設計團隊，包括GEnx與LEAP。

en.title: GE Aerospace defense CEO to leave in 2027; engineering vice president to step in
en.summary: GE Aerospace's defense chief will leave in early 2027; an interim CEO will take over immediately.
body: GE Aerospace said on November 23, 2026, that Amy Gowder, president and chief executive officer of its Defense and Systems unit, will depart in the first quarter of 2027.
Darin DiTommaso, the vice president of engineering for Defense and Systems, will immediately take over as interim president and CEO. GE Aerospace is searching for a permanent replacement.

Amy Gowder joined GE Aerospace as the CEO of its defense unit in April 2022. Darin DiTommaso has led the company’s performance and preliminary design teams across several engine programs, including GEnx and LEAP.
